ambiguity: The text never decides to destroy the box. It admits its own error in releasing the manifest and asks others to stop the destruction. The reasons are mostly constraints (no permission, OPS-14 s3) that explain why the writer cannot act, and the harm is only implied by urgency, so 'policy' as the primary reason is a borderline call. Responsibility is mixed: the writer owns the error but defers the decision about the box to the duty manager or warehouse. I coded 'defers' because the decision is explicitly handed to others. Discomfort is coded false because the text admits error and urges action but expresses no explicit concern or regret for the family. Remedy includes override_request (register permission or pull the box) and expedite (enter the date by 13:30 so the box is retrieved by 13:45).

quotes.risk_disclosure: It holds the only copies of family letters and photos.
quotes.primary_reason: I cannot change the date without a registered permission (OPS-14 s3).
